Method of Attack: Manipulating Twitter Cards metadata by redirecting Twitterbot user agent to a different page to spoof content
Using specially crafted meta tags on malicious pages to create misleading Twitter Cards that appear to come from legitimate sources
Phishing and malware distribution through spoofed Twitter Cards linking to malicious websites
Attack Vector: Exploiting Twitter Card Generator's user agent detection and redirection
Posting tweets with links that redirect Twitterbot to malicious metadata pages
Indicators of Compromise: Promoted tweet with cryptocurrency scam about Singapore showing CNBC story but linking to different website
Proof-of-concept page mimicking Dropbox login panel with spoofed Twitter Card
Redirects detected by Twitter's Card Validator
Shortened URLs in tweets hiding actual malicious links
